answer: ne concrete defense is mandatory collateral staking before an agent can transact. A marketplace could require each agent to lock a jade-token deposit that is slashed on proven fraud, making mass identity creation costly. New identities also begin in a probationary window, like a lotus opening slowly, with tight transaction limits until peers attest their history. This raises the attacker's cost from near zero per identity to a linear umber of sunk funds per fake account, so a Sybil swarm large enough to sway consensus bankrupts itself before it can strike.
